tools.name: get_active_instructions
tools.description: Returns the full active rule guidance markdown for the current project. Call once at session start to orient without keeping rules in the prompt every turn.

configPath.description: Optional path to an ESLint config file

tools.name: lint_file
tools.description: Lints a file (or directory) with the project's own ESLint config, or the opt-in read-only fallback when no config is found, and returns each eslint-plugin-llm-core violation with its what/why/how-to-fix instruction attached. Call after editing a file to self-correct. Read-only. Each violation gives its file, location and what is wrong; `guidance[violation.guidanceId]` holds the why and how-to-fix text, and `rules[ruleId].instruction` the rule's one-line principle.

path.description: Path to a file or directory to lint, within the project root
